name: Tiledesk
description: Open live-chat and customer-support platform with LLM-powered chatbots, a visual flow designer and handoff to human agents.
whatItDoes: Lets support teams put a chat widget and messaging channels in front of customers, answer with AI bots grounded in their knowledge base and escalate to people. Conversations are managed in a shared agent dashboard.
howItWorks: The community edition is a set of services for the API, dashboard, widget, bot engine and messaging, deployed together with Docker Compose or Helm. Bots are designed as flows that can call language models and a knowledge base. This repository holds the deployment files and links to the component repos.

requirements.name: Docker and Docker Compose
requirements.description: Used to start the community stack
